desc:
PRANK THE TEACHER!

🎒 STUDENTS: Sneak snacks, pass notes, play games, and pull ridiculous pranks while the teacher isn’t looking. Act innocent… or get caught!

👀 TEACHER: Keep an eye on the class, catch students causing trouble, and send them to the quiet corner. Good luck keeping everyone under control!

😂 Slime, banana peels, air horns, and more!
🤫 Sneak under desks and help your friends out of trouble.
👥 Play with up to 10 players, alongside a classroom full of NPC classmates.

Can you survive the lesson without getting caught?
